reason: All 18 frozen-ruler units passed an independent fail-closed audit. Against no prefix cache, HYPIC reduced mean TTFT by 43.6345%, TPOT by 18.9911%, and duration by 26.6028%, while increasing output throughput by 36.0663%. Strict treatment hot-path evidence passed. LongBench-v2 changed by -0.2625pp and GSM8K by -0.1516pp; both deltas are smaller than the corresponding observed baseline three-run ranges (5.5118pp and 0.3791pp). This supports adoption for this exact workload with continued quality monitoring, not a universal lossless or topology-independent claim.

historical_comparison.conclusion: The performance direction and approximate magnitude reproduced; absolute-value identity is out of scope because model, hardware generation and tensor parallelism differ.

gsm8k.interpretation: closely reproduces the employee -0.17pp point estimate and is within measured baseline repeat variability

allowed_claims: The current Qwen3.6-27B TP4 no-cache versus HYPIC-only case completed 18 of 18 planned units with zero audit errors.
The two arms used the same 40960 physical token budget and differed only by VLLM_ASCEND_HYPIC_ENABLE.
The employee performance direction and approximate magnitude reproduced on the current, different topology.
No material quality regression was observed relative to measured baseline repeat ranges on LongBench-v2 and GSM8K.
forbidden_claims: The current absolute latency or accuracy values are identical to the employee Qwen3.5-27B TP2 result.
HYPIC is lossless for every dataset, model, topology or traffic shape.
The rejected 16384-budget experiment or the separate PDC-coexistence profile can be pooled into this A/B.
next_gate: Maintainer review and repetition on a new model/topology must create a new experiment identity and fresh baseline.
